notes:
Beta 1.5.18 - minimal M3 Expressive update sheet + SFX.

Update popup redesigned: dropped the version pill row, animated arrow and shimmer. Hero now uses a larger M3 Expressive title with a single quiet subtitle showing the version transition inline (vOLD → vNEW). Change-note bullets collapsed to one accent colour for a cleaner read. Padding and type hierarchy tuned for breathing room.

SFX: short non-intrusive tones now play on key plugin actions (popup open, action click, success, error, restart). Uses ToneGenerator so no audio assets are shipped; silently no-ops on any failure.
